name: 阅读
description: Legado 阅读（文本源）：搜索 / 发现 / 详情 / 目录 / 正文，书源 JSON 与安卓版兼容；可导入、检测、删废源。插件内置跨域+GBK 代理与本地存储（书源/书架/进度落数据目录 <dataDir>/legado-web/，更新插件不丢）。
descriptionEn: Legado reader (text book sources): search / explore / info / TOC / content with Android-compatible book source JSON, plus source import, health checking and dead-source cleanup. Ships its own CORS+GBK proxy, local store, and AI tools (legado_rules / legado_book_sources / legado_source_probe / legado_run_rule) so the agent can diagnose and repair book sources.
